In my SAP Datasphere & SAC Analytics Project I modeled a sales dataset into a star schema and built an Analytic Model with calculated measures and time hierarchies, visualized in SAC dashboards. At Walstar Technologies I built a Python/OpenCV grading pipeline with 95% accuracy that cut manual grading time by 80%.

Your role asks for SQL, Python and Power BI. I haven't used Power BI yet, but my SAC dashboard work transfers directly and I learn BI tools quickly. I'd also be glad to be considered for the DevOps Intern role, where my Docker and Jenkins CI/CD work on StockPilot applies.

I graduate from VIT Vellore in 2026 with a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering and can join immediately, remote, hybrid or onsite. GitHub: https://github.com/vedantp3 Portfolio: https://vedantpatil.vercel.app Resume attached.
